notablePrerequisites:
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Activate Sakashima of a Thousand Faces by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
